pages.title: Giraffe
pages.text: The giraffe ($(o)Giraffa camelopardalis$()) is a large African mammal that lives in the savannas and open woodlands of sub-Saharan Africa.$(br2)It is the tallest living land animal, though its long neck contains only seven vertebrae, the same number as most other mammals.$(br2)Giraffes browse on the leaves of tall trees such as acacias, stripping them with a long, dark prehensile tongue, and both sexes bear skin-covered horns called ossicones.
